<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve the typical chemical shift range for aromatic carbons with retrieve_carbon_shifts. By counting how many peaks in the spectrum fall within that aromatic range, I can report the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
